cluster_summary: This cluster contains vulnerabilities related to improper use of cryptographic primitives (weak PRNG, insecure modes, insufficient key protection) and failure to validate trust boundaries in inter-component communication (mutable intents, unverified package identity, side-channel). The former lead to predictable ciphertext, key exposure, or credential compromise; the latter allow injection, redirection, or unauthorized access.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled property names, bean paths, binding keys, or conversion metadata into bean introspection, property-copy, nested binding, conversion, or reflective access APIs. Report code paths where dangerous meta-properties, nested class-loader paths, or reflective properties are not suppressed before binding. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should denylist dangerous meta-properties, restrict nested binding, and avoid exposing reflective class-loader reachable fields.

mechanism.missing_guard: dangerous meta-properties, nested class-loader paths, or reflective properties are not suppressed before binding
mechanism.name: bean property reflection escape
mechanism.sink_shape: bean introspection, property-copy, nested binding, conversion, or reflective access APIs
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled property names, bean paths, binding keys, or conversion metadata
mechanism.typical_fix: denylist dangerous meta-properties, restrict nested binding, and avoid exposing reflective class-loader reachable fields

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Check ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM flag before trusting the package context.
sub_patterns.name: Unverified system package identity for code loading
sub_patterns.root_cause: Code creates package context for a hardcoded package name without verifying it is a system app, allowing a malicious app with same name to provide code.
